attributes.name: Van Dyke Technology Group Inc
attributes.blurb: Provides advanced cybersecurity services and solutions.
attributes.summary:
The Van Dyke Technology Group, Inc. is a 180-person cybersecurity firm specializing in identity and access management, threat mitigation and other cybersecurity solutions for enterprise networks and cloud-based IT environments.
Registered Delaware USA 24 Jan 2002.

Based in Maryland, Van Dyke provides advanced cybersecurity services and solutions designed to protect sensitive information within classified networks, with a focus on supporting the U.S. Intelligence Community (IC).
